value.offerSummary: GRADION is a mid-size Vietnam-based digital/deep-tech consultancy (23+ years, 300+ staff, 100+ clients) hiring a client-facing delivery lead for its Ho Chi Minh City office. The job is really two things at once: running long-term "Dedicated Team" engagements where you keep an outsourced team healthy and productive, and running fixed-scope, fixed-price client projects where your job is to hold the line on scope and margin. It leans on you being the person who pushes back on the client and the internal team equally, and it expects AI tools to be part of your daily toolkit, not a novelty. It's an agency/vendor role, not an in-house PM seat — that's the biggest shift from your current work.

salary.note: The advert does not say. You'll have to ask directly, and given the dual title (IT Project Manager / Senior Project Manager) it's worth asking early since it likely affects the band.

strengths.requirement: University degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field
strengths.evidence: Master's Degree in Computer Science, specialization in Machine Learning, ESIEA — Paris, France, 2017.
strengths.line: I hold a Master's in Computer Science, specialised in Machine Learning, from ESIEA in Paris.

strengths.requirement: 5+ years of IT development project-management experience
strengths.evidence: Senior Project Manager with 7+ years of experience delivering banking, fintech, and SaaS solutions in regulated environments.
strengths.line: I've spent seven-plus years as a Project Manager delivering banking, fintech and SaaS solutions in regulated environments.

strengths.requirement: Experience working with cross-cultural, English-speaking teams
strengths.evidence: Coordinate cross-functional, international teams (developers, QA, business analysts, cybersecurity, external vendors) across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Africa, managing scope, timelines, risks, and dependencies on mission-critical systems.
strengths.line: I coordinate cross-functional international teams — developers, QA, analysts, cybersecurity, vendors — spread across Europe, Asia-Pacific and Africa, every day.

strengths.evidence: Act as primary interface between IT, business stakeholders, and external partners; run regular stakeholder reviews and solution demonstrations. / English (Fluent).
strengths.line: English is my working language for stakeholder reviews, demos and cross-border coordination across three continents.

strengths.requirement: Track record translating unclear client requirements into deliverable scope
strengths.evidence: Translated business and user needs into functional specifications and user stories for development teams.
strengths.line: At Okoone I translated business and user needs directly into functional specs and user stories the dev team could build from.

strengths.requirement: Confidence raising risks and difficult topics early
strengths.evidence: Maintain a formal risk register across active projects, proactively tracking, escalating, and mitigating risks to protect delivery integrity and governance compliance on mission-critical banking systems.
strengths.line: I keep a formal risk register across every active project and escalate issues before they become blockers.

strengths.requirement: Daily comfort with AI tools and sound judgement about output verification
strengths.evidence: Designed and delivered 10 AI workshops for the eBanking department (~30 participants), driving practical and compliant AI adoption across the team. / Brings advanced AI methods into day-to-day project delivery, designing LLM-driven workflows and prompting techniques to accelerate analysis, documentation, and decision-making.
strengths.line: I use AI tools daily in my own delivery work, and I've trained more than 30 colleagues on using them responsibly — including checking outputs before they go anywhere.

strengths.evidence: Built Ship24.com from scratch into a scalable cross-border logistics platform within 2 years... 16M website visitors; 3000+ active API subscriptions; +30% user growth (YoY); +50% advertising revenue growth (YoY).
strengths.line: I built Ship24.com from nothing into a platform with 16 million annual visitors in two years — that's the growth mindset this role needs.

strengths.requirement: Hands-on technical experience or solid software-development process knowledge (a plus)
strengths.evidence: Technical Foundations: SQL; Python; Jenkins; Machine learning / Deep learning fundamentals.
strengths.line: I have hands-on technical grounding — SQL, Python, Jenkins, and machine learning fundamentals — beyond just managing the process.

gaps.requirement: Hands-on experience running both Dedicated Team and Fixed-Price projects
gaps.closest: Managed scope, budget and delivery timelines end-to-end for a product team (Okoone), and coordinated long-term embedded international teams on mission-critical banking programs (BRED) — but neither ran under a named Dedicated-Team or Fixed-Price vendor contract.
gaps.line: All my project work so far has been in-house, not under vendor contracts. But I've owned scope, budget and timelines end to end, and I've run long-term embedded delivery teams — that maps closely onto both models. I'd want to walk through how the commercial guardrails differ before saying I've done this exact thing.

interviewPrep: Be ready to explain the bridge from owning scope, budget and timelines on internal product and banking programs to running formally-contracted Dedicated Team and Fixed-Price engagements.
Be ready to explain the bridge from designing and delivering 10 AI workshops and LLM-driven workflows to using AI tools daily for requirements review, risk analysis and stakeholder reporting.
Be ready to explain the bridge from translating business needs into functional specs at Okoone to turning ambiguous client requirements into an executable, scoped plan.
Be ready to explain the bridge from coordinating teams across Europe, Asia-Pacific and Africa to working daily with cross-cultural, English-speaking teams in a client-facing role.
Be ready to explain the bridge from building Ship24 from scratch to identifying account-growth opportunities and contributing to business development.
